WHY THE BUILD IS NOT RED TODAY, DERIVED AND NOT WAIVED. tooling/ci/assert-name-clearance.mjs weighs a wall against tooling/ci/channel-arming.mjs: ios-appstore and macos-appstore are `served: false` with `lane: null`, so neither can reach a user, and the guard PRINTS the finding on every run instead of blocking. The day a lane lands for either, this same unchanged record turns the guard red. Nothing has to be remembered for that to happen.

The trademark ruling is OWED, not answered. subly.app resolves to a live commercial site in the same category, and no software can clear a trademark. `ruling: null` reads as QUALIFIED and prints as FAILING; its block is lifted only until gatedUntil, and --execute preserves that date rather than rewriting it, so a re-probe cannot extend its own gate.
